subject: ACME Map POC — Post-call recap & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Map POC — Post-call recap & mutual action plan

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for making time today. Quick recap from our discovery call + proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have alignment on pain, goals, owners and dates. Please confirm and/or correct anything below.

Pain points we heard
- Current map/geocoding pipeline has high latency at peak loads (400–600ms per request) which impacts UX on mobile apps.
- Unit cost for batch geocoding is higher than expected; looking to reduce per-request cost by ~40% at scale.
- Quality inconsistencies on edge cases (custom POI matching) requiring manual correction.

Goals for the POC
- Reduce 95th percentile latency to <200ms for the map stack under 500 RPS.
- Demonstrate cost per 1M geocoding tokens reduction of >=30%.
- Validate quality on ACME-specific POI dataset (95%+ match rate on test set).

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (milestones & owners)
1) Security questionnaire returned — ACME security (Samantha) — target: 2027-06-18
2) Provide SOC2 report & security docs — Redwood (Marissa/Dylan) — target: 2027-06-20
3) Pilot environment & integration (tech handshake + data sample) — Redwood Eng (Dylan) & ACME Eng (Tom) — target: 2027-07-05 start
4) Pilot run & evaluation (2 weeks) — ACME Product & Redwood — target: 2027-07-19
5) SOW sign & procurement — ACME Procurement (TBD) & Redwood Sales — target: 2027-07-02

Open items / questions
- Please confirm primary procurement and legal contacts for SOW routing.
- Confirm decision process (who signs, required approvals).
- Any hard blackout dates in June/July we should avoid for integrator time?

Attachments: redwood-pricing.pdf (pricing deck), redwood-map-sow.pdf (draft SOW)

Next steps
- I’ll drop our SOC2 summary and updated SOW with the timeline adjusted per your feedback.
- Can we target a follow-up touchpoint the week of 2027-06-21 to close security items?

Thanks!

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-6271

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — overall this matches what we discussed. A few clarifications on our side:

Stakeholders / approvers
- Product: Tom Ruiz (VP Product) — evaluation & technical sign-off
- Procurement: Nina Patel (Procurement Manager) — contracting & PO
- Legal: legal@acme.com — standard review (they may request a standard addendum)

Decision process
- Product validates pilot metrics and recommends go/no-go to Procurement
- Procurement finalizes SOW and issues PO; Exec sponsor (myself) gives final nod for spend > $250k

Timeline adjustments
- We’d like to target pilot start week of 2027-07-05 if possible (internal roadmap).
- Security questionnaire attached — I’ve started it and flagged a couple of items we’ll need SOC2 evidence for.

Attachments: security-questionnaire-acme.xlsx

Hi all —

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Samantha. Per your feedback I updated the MAP below with confirmed stakeholders and tightened milestone dates to hit your July start. Please review and confirm.

Updated Mutual Action Plan (final draft)
- 2027-06-18: ACME returns completed security questionnaire (Samantha) — status: received (partial)
- 2027-06-20: Redwood provides SOC2 summary, architecture diagram, and data handling doc (Marissa/Dylan) — attachment: redwood-security-summary.pdf (sent)
- 2027-06-25: Security review complete (ACME Sec + Redwood) — target remediation window (if needed)
- 2027-07-02: SOW finalized and countersigned by both parties (Nina Patel / Redwood Sales)
- 2027-07-05: Pilot environment provisioning & data exchange (Dylan + ACME Eng) — 1 week integration
- 2027-07-12 to 2027-07-26: Pilot run + evaluation (Product + Redwood) — measure latency, cost, quality
- 2027-07-28: Final recommendation & procurement decision (ACME Product / Procurement)

Action items assigned
- Marissa: Share SOC2 artifacts and updated SOW (attached: redwood-map-sow.pdf, redwood-pricing.pdf) — 2027-06-20
- Dylan: Schedule onboarding call with ACME Eng and provide integration checklist — 2027-06-21
- Samantha: Complete security questionnaire and route to ACME Sec (copied) — 2027-06-18
- Nina: (Procurement) provide standard PO process & contract routing details — please confirm

Notes on decision criteria
- Primary go/no-go metric: 95th percentile latency <200ms under test load + >=30% cost improvement vs baseline
- Secondary: quality validation on ACME POI dataset (95%+ match on holdout set)

Attachments included: redwood-map-sow.pdf, redwood-pricing.pdf (please route SOW to Nina and legal@acme.com when ready).

If this looks good I’ll circulate an updated SOW with the July dates and request a short signature from Nina to lock the pilot.

Best,

—
